text: Here's Rao Fang in one minute. A guest gives feedback, and the host learns what it means.
At the end of the tour, the host hands over the phone. The guest picks a language, agrees to a short consent, rates each part of the tour, and leaves a comment. It all stays on the phone.

Later, the host opens her insights, in Thai. How happy guests were, the best and worst part of the tour, and a card for each topic she can listen to. Every number opens the real comments, and anything unclear waits for her.
She can also teach it her own dialect, Kham Mueang, by confirming or fixing starter words.
Rao Fang works offline, on the phone she already has. Try it at rao-fang dot vercel dot app.
